item: how_it_ended carries died_into_phase: the last phase and the seconds from its first sighting to the session's last record
summary: The session marks gain phase_since (set only when the phase changes). died_into_phase is the phase plus seconds_phase_start_to_last_record, a lower bound because the last record is the last observe call and not the moment of death. Where the phase or its start was not recorded (an older build, no record, a moved clock) the seconds are null with a reason, never 0. Measured 116 B with the new mark, 123 B in the null case, inside the 130 B margin.
